text:
maria: quick sync — we're sizing Dedicated for the new 40B q4f16 variant. ran region bench last night, want to lock concurrency targets and headroom before we open sales.
jamal: results looked decent for h100 in us-west, but eu-west tail is worse. do you have the p99 numbers?
maria: us-west H100 (q4f16): p50=45ms p95=120ms p99=210ms throughput@concurrency=32 ~ 420 tok/s. eu-west H100 (q4f16): p50=58ms p95=180ms p99=420ms throughput@32 ~ 380 tok/s.
ashley: int8 quant gave slightly better throughput but p99 regressed in eu on the new kernel. q4f16 seems more stable across regions.
devon: key ops question: what's our concurrency target per GPU for Dedicated? we usually budget for 60% of bench concurrency to hit p99 SLO with warm cache.
maria: target per-GPU concurrency for baseline plan: 24 per slab (we use slab=1 GPU). that's 75% of bench concurrency to give headroom for bursts.
jamal: kernels: kernel-v2 (fused-attn) on H100 has best linear throughput, but on a100 the tiled attention kernel (kernel-legacy) wins for latency at low seq len. we should map kernels by region GPU mix.
li: infra note — eu fleet currently 30% a100, 70% h100. us-west 90% h100. if we assign uniform concurrency we'll oversubscribe eu.
maria: proposal: per-region GPU mix-aware concurrency profile. us-west: 28/gpu, eu-west: 20/gpu. global autoscale buffer +30% headroom.
ashley: can we fallback model variant when kernel mismatch causes long tails? e.g., if kernel-v2 p99 > 300ms switch to q4f16-legacy or lower concurrency policy.
devon: yes we can set a routing policy: prefer kernel-v2, fallback to kernel-legacy or smaller batch size. ops-wise we need an autoscale cushion to absorb warmup (cache miss) bursts.
autoscale-bot: scheduled autoscale-policy update queued: profile "40b-q4f16-dedicated" will get min_replicas=2, target_concurrency=24, buffer=0.3. apply in 15m.
jamal: one more datapoint: cold-slab warmup adds ~150ms to first few requests for this model. recommend a warmup job post-provisioning.
li: ops config snippet i tested for canary warmup:
```
canary:
  prewarm: true
  warmup_requests: 50
  parallelism: 4
```
maria: ok action items: 1) jamal plumb region-specific concurrency table into capacity calc (us-west eu-west ap-southeast). 2) devon add warmup job to Dedicated on-provision. 3) li push autoscale profile with +30% buffer and kernel fallback rule. 4) ashley run int8 vs q4f16 regression on eu a100 and report.
ashley: will run the q/ int8 sweep today and post numbers.
devon: i'll draft the rollout playbook: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automatic rollback on p99 spike > 25%.
maria: thanks all — let's regroup after the sweep. :thumbsup:
